title: Provenance ledger borrow record
description: One line of provenance/borrows.jsonl — a single conscious external-code borrow. Contract: provenance/README.md. Enforced by src/scripts/lint_provenance.ts (hand-rolled validator, following the ticket.schema.json / ticket-manifest.schema.json precedent — this file documents the contract; it is not loaded at runtime).

source_url.description: Where the borrowed code came from.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the source's license, or the literal 'unknown'. 'unknown' and any deny-class SPDX id (GPL/AGPL/SSPL family, under the default conservative policy) fail the linter — an unresolved license must never land in the ledger (principle #1: unknown escalates, never down-guessed).

source_sha.description: Commit or blob SHA the borrow was taken from.

files.description: Repo-relative paths touched by the borrow. Every path must exist and must not escape the repo root.

transformation_note.description: What structurally changed. Rename-only phrasing is rejected — per principle #6, rename-only is not transformation; clearing requires structural re-derivation (the hit disappears on rescan) or an attributed ledger entry describing an actual structural change.

cleared_by.description: How the borrow was cleared: an automated rescan found the hit gone after rewrite, this ledger entry itself is the clearance, or a human reviewed and cleared it.
